name: Wall-Mounted Steel Pull-Up Bar with Foam Grips
description: A steel pull-up bar that bolts to a wall on two arms, with foam grips for a wide hold, a narrow hold and two parallel hammer-style grips. The bar is 97 cm overall, 51 cm between the arms, and the arms reach 30 cm out from the wall; each wall plate is 18 × 10 cm. A small eyelet ring sits in the centre of the bar. It needs drilling: fix it into a solid wall with bolts suited to the wall, as no fixings are shown with the set.

supplier.name: Yongkang Jiaxiang Fitness Equipment Co., Ltd.

source.notes: MINIMUM ORDER 10 pieces. STORE RETURN RATE 58.6% shown plainly on the page (very high if a real return rate; the same shop's door-bar page shows a 59% repurchase rate, so it may be mistranslated; unconfirmed). Supplier: Yongkang Jiaxiang Fitness Equipment Co., Ltd., same shop as telescopic-door-pull-up-bar. Title: 'Wall horizontal bar manufacturers directly supply pull-up body to upgrade the whole Pole version with sandbag swing ring 4kg class'; the sandbag wording is left out: no sandbag is in the photos and none is promised, the 'ring' is a central eyelet. Price tiers CNY 60 (about N13,399.97) for 10+, CNY 40.9 (about N9,134.31) for 50-998, CNY 39.9 for 999+; also a 'distribution' price of CNY 60 for 10+; fx_rate 223.33 = 13399.97 / 60. unit_cost unset until the owner chooses the tier. 'Standard Consolidation - Air to Nigeria' is offered. Attributes: brand '100 million Unified person' (supplier label, unused), steel, item no. ytz006, origin Yongkang, Zhejiang. Colours Black and White, 4,100 g each (shipping.weight_kg 4.1, supplier-stated); no packed carton size given: heavy and bulky, freight will weigh heavily on margin. Dimensions from the supplier's measured photo (white bar): bar 97 cm overall, 51 cm between arms, arms 30 cm out, plates 18 x 10 cm; assumed the same for the black bar (not stated). Four grips seen: wide, narrow and two parallel hammer grips (foam, black with orange rings). NO load rating or capacity claim: none given; owner may want one from the supplier before selling. Wall fixings not shown and not claimed as included. The only white-bar photo is the supplier's measured shot on a wood floor (800 px, soft, red dimension lines, blurred fill to 4:5); black photos are cutouts from 800 px originals, soft. Reviews (30+): comfortable sponge grips; not quoted.
